filerStatus.registerSection: JSE SENS delay in publication and suspension of listing
filerStatus.source: JSE SENS, Sable Exploration and Mining delay in publication of annual financial statements for the year ended 28 February 2025 and suspension of listing, 13 August 2025, and quarterly update on suspension 18 December 2025, read 22 November 2026
filerStatus.reasonShort: The year ended 28 February 2025 was not published in time because a new auditor had to be appointed after a reportable irregularity process, and the JSE suspended the listing from 13 August 2025. The December 2025 quarterly update records that no auditor had yet been appointed.
